name: claudedeck
description: ClaudeDeck by SysTech — Self-hosted web UI for Claude Code CLI
author: SysTech Łukasz Grzywacki

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @claudedeck/backend" "npm run dev -w @claudedeck/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @claudedeck/shared && npm run build -w @claudedeck/backend && npm run build -w @claudedeck/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @claudedeck/shared && npm run typecheck -w @claudedeck/backend && npm run typecheck -w @claudedeck/frontend
